system.description: You can use the Obfuscate Discipline to hide while you sleep during the day. You must spend an extra Blood Trait (in addition to any required by Obfuscate itself) before lying down to sleep in order to keep your body hidden for a full day. You must still be hidden from direct sunlight, and vampires using Auspex can still detect you, but mortals will ignore your presence entirely. Requires Storyteller permission to take. A useful Merit for Nosferatu emissaries and travelers, many of whom would perish without it.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter One ("Legends and History"), "Merits and Flaws"
